newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says steel division improving.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says steel division improving.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Friday the underlying performance of its steel division was improving.
"We are gradually getting on top of the issues in steel," John Prescott, managing director of BHP, said in a recorded statement released to the media.
BHP earlier on Friday said profits from the steel division had fallen 39 percent in the half-year ended November 30 to A$180 million compared to the same period a year ealier.
An improving steel division was being "masked a bit" by relining costs at BHP's Newcastle steelworks, Prescott said.
Prescottt also said an unfavourable currency exchange rate due to a strong Australian dollar would contine to affect BHP's businesses.
"We have to face up to the fact that we're in an era of higher exchange rates," Prescott said.
"The impact on BHP half-year on half-year (June 1-November 30 1996 versus June 1-November 30 1995) was about A$100 million," he added.
A stronger Australian dollar devalues BHP's exported products in domestic currency terms.
